item.title: Fatal crash closes I-40 WB lanes near Watkins St.
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. — All westbound lanes of Interstate 40 near Watkins St. are blocked due to a fatal multi-vehicle crash. The crash happened near mile marker three. Emergency crews are on the scene, as shown on the TDOT cameras. WREG is working to learn more information about this crash.
